findings.title: Materials: 122% earnings hope despite steep discounts
findings.body: Materials forward multiple sits at 16.66x versus 36.99x trailing, a 60-point percentile gap — the widest in the table. Analysts expect 122 percent earnings growth, but that optimism clashes with a sector stuck near the 28th percentile; the market is underwriting a turnaround that is all promise and no evidence yet.

findings.title: Health Care: 99th percentile forward, 44% compression
findings.body: Health Care trades at a forward P/E of 19.98 and a trailing P/E of 35.48, with a 22-point percentile gap. The 44 percent compression implies an unusual bet on 78 percent earnings growth, which feels aggressive for a sector already priced at the 99th percentile of its five-year range.

findings.title: Energy: cheap forward, rich trailing — 23-point gap
findings.body: Energy's forward P/E of 11.23 sits in the 34th percentile while its trailing 15.29x is in the 57th, a 23-point gap showing the market expects earnings growth of 36 percent. This is a contrarian setup: the multiple has fallen 10 points in a month, yet the forward view still assumes a strong rebound that the trailing data has not supported.
